question_text: Were JPMorgan Chase, Visa and Mastercard hacked through a vendor?
answer_text: Through vendors, by their own account. JPMorgan Chase says outside firms that provide it services were hit by a cyberattack that reached marketing data, maybe some names and emails. Visa and Mastercard each say a provider had an incident.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Were card numbers or payment data taken in the JPMorgan vendor breach?
answer_text: The companies say no. Visa says no card numbers or payment data were affected; Mastercard says only some email addresses were exposed; JPMorgan Chase says marketing data was reached. That is their word; no one outside has checked.
label: Reported

question_text: Who claims to be behind the JPMorgan Chase vendor breach?
answer_text: A group calling itself n0n, which claimed on Nov 16 to have JPMorgan Chase customer data and posted similar claims about Visa and Mastercard. This is the group's claim; none of the companies has said who was behind it.
label: Reported

what_would_settle_it: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, Mastercard or the vendor naming the company that was attacked.

question_text: How many JPMorgan Chase customers were affected?
what_would_settle_it: One of the companies or a regulator's breach notice giving the number of customers affected.

question_text: Was the vendor breach behind JPMorgan Chase's service problems that week?
answer_text: JPMorgan Chase says no: the vendor attack has no connection to the service disruption some customers had earlier that week, which was reported as caused by a software bug. That is the company's word.
label: Reported

question_text: What should JPMorgan Chase customers do?
answer_text: JPMorgan Chase says it will contact affected customers directly and, where appropriate, offer support including free credit monitoring. Visa and Mastercard say people can keep using their cards.
label: Confirmed

question_text: When did the attack on the vendors happen?
what_would_settle_it: One of the companies or the vendor giving the dates of the attack.
